name: default_semi_synthetic_n34_k32_tau0p1_pos0p5_seed42
description: Default semi-synthetic Bernoulli Task II panel: R01-R34, K=32 references after excluding A/B, tau=0.1, target annotator-population positive rate 0.50.
reference_rule: For every A/B pair, use all remaining 32 annotators as references.

intercept_population_mc.method: Independent random-network Monte Carlo for f(z)-E_X f(X), plus C~N(0,tau^2), used only to solve a_h. The actual finite panel annotators are sampled from a separate random stream.

split_output.policy: Use the existing Task II split membership by image_id. Assign test if an image appears in any source test CSV, else val if it appears in any source val CSV, else train.
split_output.purpose: Compatibility with the existing Bernoulli multitask-MSE train/val/test CSV interface. Oracle calculations always use the complete fixed embedding pool.

kappa_generation: kappa is not a data-generation input and is not preset for the eventual test.
